```{r}
library(rmarkdown)
library(readr)
library(shiny)
```

```{r}
#| context: data
eclipses <- read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ma-ulloa/eclipsaR/main/data/formatted_eclipses.csv")

eclipses$Date <- as.Date(eclipses$Date)
eclipses$Year <- format(eclipses$Date, "%Y")      
years <- sort(unique(eclipses$Year))   
```


```{r}
#| context: server

shinyApp(
ui = fluidPage(
  selectInput("year_input", label = "Select year", choices = NULL),
  selectInput("eclipse_input", label = "Select eclipse", choices = NULL),
  tableOutput("detail_output")
),

server=function(input,output,session) {

  # year (static)
  updateSelectInput(session, "year_input", choices = sort(years))

  # eclipses that happened in the selected year
  year_rows <- reactive({
    req(input$year_input)
    eclipses[eclipses$Year == as.integer(input$year_input), ]
  })
  
 observe({
    df <- year_rows()
    labels <- paste0(format(df$Date, "%Y-%m-%d"), " (", df$Type, ")")
    choices <- setNames(format(df$Date, "%Y-%m-%d"), labels)
    updateSelectInput(session, "eclipse_input", label = "Select eclipse", choices = choices)
  })

  # eclipse the user picked
  selected_row <- reactive({
    req(input$eclipse_input)
    year_rows()[format(year_rows()$Date, "%Y-%m-%d") == input$eclipse_input, ]
  })

  # --- "consequent actions" go here - this is just a placeholder --------
  # replace/extend this with whatever you want to do once one eclipse is
  # picked: plot it on a map, show its path width, look up nearby cities...
  output$detail_output <- renderTable({
    req(selected_row())
    selected_row()[, c("Date", "Type", "Gamma", "Magnitude", "Central_Duration",
                        "Latitude", "Longitude", "Continents", "Geographical_Area")]
  })
},
options=list(height=600))
```
